summary.text: FJORDLYS MASKIN AS is an aksjeselskap in Bergen registered for machinery production, with 42 registered employees. Filed 2025 accounts show revenue of NOK 48,210,000 and an annual result of NOK 2,310,000. Ingrid Solheim is the registered general manager. Its verified website links to LinkedIn and Facebook profiles and describes the business as "Vi lager hydrauliske løfteverktøy for verft og industri." NAV lists two open job ads under this org number, the latest published on 2 October 2026. The registry recorded a board change on 11 June 2026.
